# 7amdi

> The personal website of 7amdi, featuring notes on web development, design, performance, experiments, photography, and listening history.

## Pages

- [Home](https://7amdi.vercel.app/): About 7amdi, social links, and current Last.fm status.
- [Thoughts](https://7amdi.vercel.app/thoughts): Articles and notes on programming, design, and experiments.
- [Gallery](https://7amdi.vercel.app/gallery): Personal photography.
- [Guestbook](https://7amdi.vercel.app/guestbook): Messages left by visitors.
- [Listening history](https://7amdi.vercel.app/mh): Recent Last.fm charts, including top tracks, artists, and albums from the past month.
